[Intro]
[F#]  [B]
[D#m]  [C#]

[Verse 1]
[F#]I spend my [B]morning strolling
[D#m]Just around the weeds [C#]and coral reefs
[F#]Hopin' with my [B]eyes open
[D#m]wide For a brand new [C#]peculiar thing
[F#]Sunk down deep [B]in the ocean
[D#m]Better than [C#]any fiction
[F#]taught to us [B]So I'd rather pick up
[D#m]all these stuff Than read [C#]all the mermaid tales

[Verse 2]
[F#]I play with those [B]round things Randomly
[D#m]floating on the [C#]surface
[F#]Made them as [B]hats or what'd you call
[D#m]that? Alright, a [C#]circus.
[F#]And these transparent things [B]Always get in the way
[D#m]When I'm simply swimming [C#]under the sun
[F#]Was kinda hooked [B]so I decided one day
[D#m][C#]I will wear

[Chorus]
[F#]one Oh isn't it [B]fun? Isn't it
[D#m]fun? Fun [C#]in the ocean
[F#]Isn't it [B]fun? Isn't it
[D#m]fun? Fun [C#]in the ocean.

[Verse 3]
[F#]I see a sparkly thing [B]I wear it like a ring
[D#m]I started wondering [C#]maybe I have everything
[F#]I heard that on land [B]people ride on boxes
[D#m]Taking 'em around From North [C#]to South and East to West
[F#]I saw in one click, they [B]replicate their own face
[D#m]Oh you really think, I'd [C#]surely be amazed When I
[F#]go there, but [B]I don't care Cause like
[D#m]who wants to get out of here If [C#]you could see these fancy wares Like
[F#]glasses and brushes and [B]this squishy stuff And these en-
[D#m]ticing different hooks, all [C#]coming from above Got me
[F#]singing at the top of my [B]gills A siren tune like
[D#m]AAAAHHH [C#]
See?

[Chorus]
[F#]Isn't it [B]fun? Isn't it
[D#m]fun? Fun [C#]in the ocean
[F#]It's always [B]fun? It's always
[D#m]fun? Fun [C#]in the ocean.

[Outro]
[F#]  [B]
[D#m]  [C#]
[F#]
